title: CycloneFeed

generated_at.description: When this feed was written. It is rewritten only when its content changes.

attribution.description: Credit to show with the data.

source_cycle.description: Latest advisory cycle read (00, 06, 12 or 18 UTC); null before the first one.

cyclones.description: Tropical cyclones with a fix in the last 60 days, by first fix, oldest first.

description: cyclones/tracks.json: tracks of tropical cyclones from the advisories of NHC, CPHC and JTWC (ADR 0039).

CycloneBasin.description: Basin letter of the storm number: L North Atlantic, E eastern North Pacific, C central North Pacific, W western North Pacific, A Arabian Sea, B Bay of Bengal, S South Indian Ocean, P South Pacific, Q South Atlantic.

time.description: Time the position is valid for.

wind_kt.description: Maximum one-minute sustained wind, knots; null when the advisory gives none.

r34_km.description: Mean radius of 34 kt winds over the quadrants that have one, km; null when the advisory gives none.

heading.description: Direction the storm moves toward, degrees clockwise from north; null when the advisory gives none.

speed_ms.description: Speed of the storm's motion, m/s; null when the advisory gives none.

CycloneFix.description: One advisory position of a cyclone.

id.description: Day of the first fix and storm number, lower case. Never changes.

number.description: Storm number of the season with its basin letter, such as 04P.

name.description: Name given by the regional centre, or the storm number while it has none.

agency.description: Centre that issued the latest fix: NHC (which includes CPHC) or JTWC.

active.description: Whether the storm had a fix in one of the last two advisory cycles read. Only an active storm may be shown past its last fix.

track.description: Fixes, oldest first, usually 6 h apart.

Cyclone.description: One tropical cyclone and its track.
